name: OpenBISmantic
purpose: Bridges an openBIS ELN/LIMS instance and the semantic web. Wraps an openBIS server with a FastAPI layer that exposes all openBIS entities (objects, datasets, collections, projects, spaces, users, property types) as resolvable RDF resources via persistent IRIs built from openBIS permanent IDs (permIds). Also produces RO-Crate export bundles for portable archival.
pipeline_position: Stage 1 extractor for openBIS ELN/LIMS data

tech_stack.technology: Docker Compose: nginx + openBIS server + PostgreSQL + API

content_negotiation.description: Same URL, different Accept header → different RDF format

api_endpoints.summary: Accept a JSON-LD graph → produce RO-Crate ZIP with all referenced dataset files

deployment_modes.name: Full stack
commands: cp .env.example .env  # fill in ADMIN_PASS, HOST_NAME, POSTGRES_PASSWORD

deployment_modes.name: API only
deployment_modes.description: Point at an existing openBIS instance

configuration.description: Public base URL for OpenBISmantic IRIs

ro_crate_output.description: POST /export_bundle accepts a JSON-LD graph of selected entities and produces a ZIP containing all referenced openBIS dataset files plus ro-crate-metadata.json conforming to the RO-Crate spec
ro_crate_output.downstream: ZIP can feed directly into RDFConverter since RDFConverter accepts JSON-LD input

capabilities: Exposes entire openBIS hierarchy as Linked Data with stable IRIs from permIds
Content negotiation — same endpoint, multiple RDF serialization formats
Portable RO-Crate export with all dataset files and metadata
End users need no openBIS credentials — service authenticates via configured service account
No SPARQL knowledge required by end users
limitations: Requires an accessible openBIS instance (no standalone operation)
No active public deployment for testing
Output uses Schema.org/DCAT/PROV-O — domain-specific ontology mapping (e.g. to MSEO) requires downstream YARRRML mapping via RDFConverter
